name: WISE
intro: WISE 是知识密集型文生图评测基准，以1,000个提示检验模型在文化常识、时空推理和自然科学中的隐含世界知识理解与视觉呈现能力，并以WiScore衡量知识—图像对齐。
metric: WiScore=(0.7×一致性+0.2×真实感+0.1×审美质量)/2，各分项为0–2分
task_type: 文本到图像生成, 世界知识推理
scale: 1,000个提示，覆盖3大领域和25个子领域
intro_en: WISE is a knowledge-intensive text-to-image benchmark whose 1,000 prompts test implicit world-knowledge understanding and visual realization across cultural common sense, spatio-temporal reasoning, and natural science, using WiScore for knowledge-image alignment.
scale_en: 1,000 prompts across three domains and 25 subdomains

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WISE arXiv:2503.07265v4, Section 3.1 and Tables 3-4 for sourcing, quality control, and the descriptive cultural-distribution audit; Section 3.2 Equation (1) and Appendices D-E for WiScore; Appendices H-I for seed and human validation; official repository https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/WISE. Version pin: this entry follows the paper WiScore protocol, not the repository-default WISE_Verified maintenance protocol. Table 4 is an audit, not a build gate.. The paper builds 1,000 knowledge-intensive text-to-image prompts across 25 subdomains from educational materials, encyclopedias and public references, common-sense problem sets, and LLM-assisted candidates. Human annotators rewrite or discard candidates to enforce visual answerability, one inferable target, stable facts, natural wording, explicit expected visual cues, and prompt-answer-explanation consistency. After the benchmark is finalized, Table 4 reports a descriptive cultural-distribution audit: full WISE is 56.6% global/neutral, 22.6% Western, and 20.8% non-Western; the Cultural Common Sense subset is 17.75%, 41.50%, and 40.75%, respectively. The paper specifies neither an acceptance threshold nor a rebalance loop. Generated images are scored by GPT-4o-2024-05-13 on consistency, realism, and aesthetic quality from 0 to 2, and WiScore is (0.7C + 0.2R + 0.1A) / 2. This entry is pinned to the paper protocol rather than the later binary WISE_Verified repository default.
